pod_id.semantics: Opaque string, not a number. Candidate uniqueness is audited at the documented grain; no cross-hour blind deduplication.

workload_id.semantics: Nullable workload grouping identity. Nulls are retained; not a unique join key and must not become an empty string.

server_id.semantics: Join identity with day/hour. Inventory/network missing or blank server keys and ALL duplicate server-hour rows are quarantined; workloads/execution missing identities are retained and reported.

cluster_id.semantics: Opaque cohort identity; missing/blank values remain explicit. Do not invent a cluster or join by row position.

state_public.semantics: Open categorical vocabulary. Unknown is not failed or inactive. Preserve and report unknown/null/blank observations.

gpu_spec_public.semantics: Open/masked model categories; no inferred vendor identity or automatic hardware interchangeability.

server_gpu_count.semantics: Capacity hint from workload record; do not multiply into fleet capacity across pods. Zero and null remain distinct.

server_cpu_capacity_cores.semantics: Preserve source capacity hint; do not multiply across workload rows. Negative values flagged.

priority_class.semantics: Open categorical vocabulary. Preserve labels; count null/blank/Unknown without inventing priority ordering.

job_type_public.semantics: Open categorical vocabulary. Do not reject a new label or equate workload types for performance analysis.

model_type_public.semantics: Open/masked categorical vocabulary; null and Unknown remain distinct and visible.

is_genai_request.semantics: Three states: true, false, unknown. Never fill null with false or infer from job/model label.

gpu_request.semantics: Preserve fractional requests and zero-GPU rows. Missing/non-finite request => unknown GPU-view membership. Negative requests are flagged, not clipped.

gpu_mem_request.semantics: Preserve raw integer and nulls; units remain unconfirmed. No conversion into bytes/GiB or comparison with measured GiB without a verified unit definition.

cpu_request_cores.semantics: Preserve fractional requests and zeros. Negative/non-finite values flagged; no arbitrary upper cap.

used_gpu_hours.semantics: Preserve partial-hour/fractional attribution. Do not assume equality to instantaneous request or infer elapsed running time.

avg_gpu_sm_util.semantics: Preserve raw source measurement; finite presence is separate from non-negative/eligible quality. No unverified range clipping or automatic reclaim interpretation.

avg_gpu_mem_gib.semantics: Preserve measured GiB and nulls; do not compare to request field until request units are verified.

avg_cpu_request_util.semantics: Ratios above 1 are allowed; never clamp to 1. Missing, measured zero and non-finite values stay distinct.

avg_memory_util.semantics: Preserve raw source units; do not assume percent, clamp, or fill missing readings with zero.

ready_delay_sec.semantics: Retain raw negative/sentinel candidates with a negative flag, even when ready_status is true. Semantics require source confirmation.
